recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. If a future work group wants a CDS Hooks-style label element, that should be handled as a new compatibility-impacting design decision rather than as unresolved FHIR-13413 work.
issue_request: FHIR-13413 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification CDS work group change request for STU3 RequestGroup in support of CDS Hooks. It requested renaming the existing label element to prefix and adding a label field; the approved resolution was to rename label to prefix while keeping title as specified for consistency with other FHIR resources.
initial_application: The change was applied in SVN 12255, mirrored in git as 571fea972c605378a443f9fa8c2bace66e61a178, which changed RequestGroup.action.label to RequestGroup.action.prefix in the RequestGroup spreadsheet source and example. No evidence found during this reconciliation showed that application was reverted.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration for R5. The current fhir.ini actively lists requestorchestration=RequestOrchestration and maps RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. The historical source/requestgroup directory is absent, while active RequestOrchestration source defines action.prefix and action.title, and examples use prefix. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-13413 conflict; a May 2017 CDS Hooks notification thread is consistent with the broader alignment context.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active conformance source already contains RequestOrchestration.action.prefix, retains RequestOrchestration.action.title, and has no active RequestOrchestration.action.label or RequestGroup.action.label source to correct.
